description: Generate Alembic migration for all SQLModel tables and verify schema completeness. Since no PostgreSQL is running, generate the migration in offline mode or use a SQLite-based approach to validate the schema.
steps: Create alembic/versions/sprint2_initial_complete_schema.py as a manual migration file that consolidates all ~50 SQLModel tables. Use 'alembic revision --autogenerate' pattern but since no DB is running, create the migration manually by: (1) reading all model definitions from src/nexus/models/, (2) writing the upgrade() function with op.create_table() for each table not already covered by existing migrations, and (3) writing the downgrade() function with op.drop_table() in reverse order. Reference existing migrations in alembic/versions/ (db96cb66effc_initial_schema.py and ca7238bc6797_add_kill_switch_records_table.py) to avoid duplicating tables they already create.
Verify the migration file is syntactically valid by importing it with Python. Run: python -c 'import alembic.versions.sprint2_...' or use ast.parse to validate syntax.

Create a test in tests/test_alembic_migration.py that: (1) imports all models from nexus.models, (2) verifies SQLModel.metadata.tables contains all expected table names, (3) verifies the new migration file exists and is valid Python, (4) optionally uses SQLite in-memory to test create_all works with the metadata.
acceptance_criteria: New migration file exists in alembic/versions/ with proper revision ID and dependencies
Migration file covers all tables from nexus.models.__init__ not in prior migrations
Migration file is syntactically valid Python
Test confirms all model tables are discoverable in SQLModel.metadata
All tests pass alongside the existing 749 tests
findings: Migration a1b2c3d4e5f6 created for circuit_breaker_records table (the only table missing a migration). Migration chain: None -> db96cb66effc -> ca7238bc6797 -> a1b2c3d4e5f6. All 900 tests pass (up from 888 baseline, additional tests from FEAT-001 through FEAT-003). Alembic migration files use annotated assignments (ast.AnnAssign) not plain ast.Assign for revision/down_revision variables. SQLModel.metadata confirms 48 tables total.
